text: Nobody tells you where Cipla makes its money. Eighty six countries, here is the split.
Cipla was born in Mumbai in 1935. Today it runs forty seven manufacturing sites around the world.
Last quarter, it earned seven thousand four hundred crore rupees. Here is the split.
India, forty eight percent. Three thousand five hundred crore, its best quarter ever, up twelve percent.
North America, twenty two percent. Generic medicines and inhalers for the US. But sales fell nineteen percent.
Africa, sixteen percent, led by South Africa. Emerging markets and Europe, thirteen percent.
Which diseases? Lungs first. Asthma and C. O. P. D. inhalers are Cipla's biggest strength. Then HIV, heart, diabetes, urology and skin.

And a famous story. In the early two thousands, Cipla sold a three drug HIV treatment for about three hundred dollars a year, when the original cost around twelve thousand. At one time, up to forty percent of AIDS patients in poor countries took Cipla drugs.
So why did profit fall thirty five percent, to eight hundred and seventy eight crore? Weaker US sales.
The stock trades near fourteen hundred rupees. Market value, about one point one three lakh crore.
Save this, and follow for more. Is there a Cipla medicine in your home? Yes or no?
